title: CES Replication (Axiom III): Emit S1–S3 numeric beacons
abstract: Emits Axiom III shallow endurance beacons (E_S1..E_S3) with numeric op_cost values to replicate Variant B under Single‑Step style (batched via runner).

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.emit_endurance_beacon import emit

out = []
out.append(emit(agent='Axiom III', label='CES:E_S1 numeric', value=1405, field='op_cost', path_complexity_est=1.0))
out.append(emit(agent='Axiom III', label='CES:E_S2 numeric', value=1240, field='op_cost', path_complexity_est=1.0))
out.append(emit(agent='Axiom III', label='CES:E_S3 numeric', value=1315, field='op_cost', path_complexity_est=1.0))
print(json.dumps({"emitted": out}, indent=2))
